seen.brief.md: The brief sets a 7.0 bar, lists critical defects, and names three known open defects on the earlier accepted pages.
seen.look-reference-nan-and-pip.png: The approved style: soft round 3D chibi girl with buns and a small dog, bright colors, smooth bodies.
seen.sprout-ben-render.png: Ben is a chibi boy about 0.9 m tall with brown hair, a blue T-shirt, and dark blue shorts, shown in four views plus a drawn reference.
seen.storytime-wall-hook.png: A light wood rail with three round-tipped pegs in blue, yellow, and green, left to right, shown in front, three-quarter, side, and back views.
seen.storytime-school-bag-ben.png: A rounded green school bag with an orange front pocket and dark blue straps and grab loop, in four views, standing on the ground.
seen.l2-w01-story-page-hello-i-am-ben-v2.png: Ben waves beside a wall rail where his green bag hangs on a peg, while a red bag sits on the floor near a crate at the left.
seen.l2-w01-story-page-hello-i-am-ben-line-v2: The same page as 1-bit line art with thick stepped strokes; a dense merged band sits on the crate lid and a short dash floats above Ben's hair.

issues: The pegs sit near the lower edge of the board rather than at mid-height; this is a design choice, not a defect.
storytime-wall-hook.notes: All four views read clean. The pegs are blue, yellow, and green against the light wood board, so each peg separates clearly. The side view shows the pegs sticking out of the board front with no floating or buried part. The back view is a plain board. No text, letter, number, logo, name label, face, or black speck appears. The item meets its classroom purpose.

storytime-school-bag-ben.notes: The bag reads as a child's school bag or backpack at once: rounded body, front pocket, two straps, and a grab loop. The body is green, the pocket is orange, and the straps are dark blue, so it does not look like Pat's red bag, and it has no round bump. It stands on the ground in all views with no floating or buried part. No text, logo, face, or speck appears.

issues: The waving hand reads as a rounded, fist-like bump at page size; this matches the known open defect and is not worse than the brief describes.
Pat's red bag reads as sitting on the floor near the crate, not held and not floating, but its round bump is not visible, so the 'moves a little' cue does not read.
A rounded quilted object with a red band sits behind Ben's right arm; the goal does not name it, and it reads as a mat or cushion.
In the line art, the crate lid plank strokes merge into one dense band, and a short dash floats above the hair at the top of Ben's head.
l2-w01-story-page-hello-i-am-ben.fix: Make the waving hand read open at page size and clear the stray dash above Ben's hair.
l2-w01-story-page-hello-i-am-ben.notes: The page shows the goal. The green bag on the wall rail matches Ben's item card, and it hangs on the left peg with the grab loop touching the peg: no floating, no bag sunk into the wall. Ben stands whole in the frame and waves. The red bag sits on the floor behind Ben to the left. No text, letter, number, logo, name label, or face appears on a prop or on the wall, and no black specks appear. Prop sizes fit a child of about five years. The eye-corner skin flap and the square stroke steps match the known open style defects and are not worse than the brief describes.
line_art: Dense blob of merged strokes: the top of the crate lid, left of Ben, where the plank lines merge into one heavy black band.
Short dash floating above the hair outline at the top of Ben's head, left of the top hair tuft.
Small isolated angled dash at the right edge of the page, mid-height, near the wall trim, with no line connected to it.
